> **JohnFP:** Dave that's excellent.What do you mean by masking? Could you ellaborate?

by making a two color dcg hologram (green and red), first exposure cover less than half the object, second exposure swell emulsion and move mask leaving more than half showing and change reference angle (slightly),and expose
